2. The present writ petition has been filed for enhancement of compensation amount which has been prepared and the petitioner has received with objection.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is entitled to receive the payment treating his land as agricultural whereas he is interested in receiving payment on Patna High Court CWJC No.7136 of 2023 dt.15-09-2023 higher value.

4.
